My cheat sheet for grilling:

Medium fire = you can hold your hand over the grill for 5 seconds. Hot fire = you can hold your hand over the grill for 2 seconds.

Fillet, rare, hot fire, 2 min a side, flip once only (if you eat fillet any other way, shoot yourself) ..(also assuming 2/3 inch thickness) Rump/Sirloin, med-rare: hot fire, 3/4 min a side, flip once only. (assuming 1 inch thickness) Fish, place in foil on med fire for 20 min, don't bother turning, done. (smoking is suggested) Chicken, about 12 minutes on medium fire, turn every 2 minutes. (when the meat is white all the way through you're done, pink meat in the center = possible trip to the hospital) ... for fellow South African's, boerewors cooks at the exact same speed as chicken. I always cook and flip them together, when the wors is firm (done), the chicken will also be done.
